namespaceScope: Exact directory/symlink identity joins only; no directory-content grant. /usr/lib/ssl/openssl.cnf is an alias of the same regular file and not a second read capability.

conditionalBranches.assessment: No active includes or nodejs_conf module selector. Node links bundled OpenSSL3.5.8 without DT_NEEDED libssl/libcrypto; default/base providers have builtin initializers. Legacy/FIPS/custom-engine choices require explicit flags/API/config and can require DSOs. Debian legacy.so belongs to a separate installed library and is not automatically a valid Node provider. No broad provider/engine grant is justified.

Node root-cert store is lazy; external system/OpenSSL CA and extra-cert reads depend on build/flags/API/env. Frozen options/environment request none of use-system-ca, use-openssl-ca, NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, SSL_CERT_FILE or SSL_CERT_DIR. Bundled roots reside in Node. This diagnosis does not certify all later TLS APIs or add certificate-directory grants.

Named GNU Node interpreter, six SONAME families, ld.so.cache and GNU fs-safe/Koffi addon targets are already regular-file-bound with aliases. Node sqlite is statically bundled. Existing static SONAME closure excludes runtime dlopen/constructors/unseen addons; musl fallback remains denied.

Image nsswitch selects files for passwd/group and files dns for hosts. libuv homedir uses supplied HOME before passwd fallback. Explicit userInfo/getpwuid/group APIs can need nsswitch/passwd/group; DNS/NSS/c-ares may try resolver/hosts paths with error/fallback handling. Docker supplies different live hosts/resolv content, so saved-image empty hashes cannot justify those live reads. Exact frozen IP/DNS denial controls do not authorize any resolver/NSS directory or network permission.

LANG=C and LC_ALL=C select glibc builtin C locale. Exact ELF has full ICU78 data/build settings and no external ICU env/CLI override. TZ=UTC can make libc timezone APIs try /usr/share/zoneinfo/UTC (alias Etc/UTC); missing/denied timezone files can fall back. Date/Intl and external ICU data paths remain behavior gates; no locale/zoneinfo directory grant is justified.

getrandom syscall318 is already in frozen admitted BPF. Modern Linux entropy success avoids device-file fallback; /dev/urandom fallback is not pre-authorized. Node/libuv cgroup/OS introspection can try proc/sys files and use unavailable-control fallbacks; no generic proc/sys read grant follows from this OpenSSL config failure.

preflightCaveat: Node --version exits before OpenSSL initialization (node.cc lines1067-1088), so a version-only executable check would not cover the observed failure. Current plan uses static exact prerequisites and no execution.

sources.supports: Startup selects OpenSSL config and nodejs_conf, sets IGNORE_MISSING_FILE and returns the OpenSSL error reason before V8/JavaScript.
--version early return precedes OpenSSL initialization; it does not exercise config access.
No appname selector means no config module load unless DEFAULT_SECTION fallback was requested.
IGNORE_MISSING_FILE accepts NO_SUCH_FILE only; EACCES persists.
Only active .include directives expand file/directory includes; commented directives do not.
Default/base/null providers use built-in initializer functions; legacy builtin depends on STATIC_LEGACY.
Only providers lacking an initializer use DSO module search/load.
Root certificate store is lazily created when needed.
Build/flags choose bundled versus system/OpenSSL CA and extra-cert reads.
Config override precedence, shared-config appname and legacy-provider flag semantics.
Bundled, OpenSSL and system CA choices are separate; system CA requires selection.
Provided HOME bypasses passwd fallback for homedir.
External ICU data needs a selected CLI/env/build path; actual ICU initialization/Intl behavior still need runtime evidence.
